check: R-0036 Phase8 Test2 causal repair: serial realtime matview refresh coalescing

defect.mechanism: The serial maintenance worker executes every queued per-event refresh task after the previous owner has released. The ownership check did not consult the minimum interval, so each queued task performed a full refresh; the interval was applied only to a trailing task after a refresh. Coalescing therefore suppressed concurrent tasks, not serial queued tasks.
defect.evidence: The failing Phase8 window recorded approximately one full five-view refresh set per event, 1692-1693 executions per view, and about 214 seconds of DB execution in those refresh statements.

repair.mechanism: The minimum interval is enforced at arrival. The first task inside the window claims the owner, reserves the next window and schedules exactly one trailing refresh; later arrivals coalesce without refreshing.

reduction.realtime_refresh_total_exec_ms: 213981 -> at most 5078.406 for the two reported views; the other three refresh statements were not in the top-25 delta

limits: The before window is from an older full-physics run; after is the exact-head corrected Phase8 run.
The coalescing store is process-local and the E2E maintenance worker is solo; multi-process worker coalescing is not claimed.
The dedicated R3 comparison has follow-up tasks disabled and is a boundary control, not a substitute for the composed Phase8 gate.
No performance threshold was weakened or changed.
Refresh-work reduction and one passing governed run are demonstrated; elimination of the intermittent slow regime is not.
B1.7 P4 failed once at the same exact head and passed on a same-head rerun; it remains independently noisy.

controlled_causal_comparison.method: Deterministic serial scheduler model over the same 2760 arrivals at 46 rps with the same 1.0 s realtime interval: legacy ownership-only coalescing versus interval-at-arrival coalescing.
controlled_causal_comparison.scope: Scheduler policy only; no database, CPU or governed Phase8 claim follows from this comparison.

demonstrated: realtime refresh execution falls from one full refresh set per event to approximately one per tenant interval
one exact-head Phase8 Test2 pass after the repair
not_demonstrated: elimination of the intermittent Phase8 slow regime
repeatable governed performance across repeated exact-head runs
